units.source_text: 其后，我又继续走到了宜津线的丹后由良站前。

en.t: After that, I kept walking until I reached the area in front of Tango-Yura Station on the Miyazu Line.

units.source_text: 沿着东舞鹤中学时代修学旅行所走的同一条路线，从这车站踏上了归途。

en.t: Following the same route I had taken on a school trip during my days at Higashi-Maizuru Middle School, I set out for home from this station.
There were few people on the road in front of the station.

units.source_text: 众所周知，本地人主要靠短暂的夏季的繁荣来维持生计。

en.t: As everyone knew, the local people made their living mainly from the brief prosperity of summer.
